EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a structured schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address fields returned from NPI data, including field types, null handling, and naming conventions.
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.evidence: GAP: No explicit schema contract exists for provider quality snapshot; must define based on provider_detail_service.py output fields

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Provider Quality Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Extract provider quality fields from NPI registry response within provider_detail_service and normalize values (e.g., credential formatting, address structuring, status standardization), including handling of missing or partial data.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via EvaluateCare API
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Integrate normalized provider quality snapshot into evaluate_care_facade and ensure it is included in FastAPI responses with strict adherence to the defined schema contract for downstream consumption.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Provider Quality Snapshot Test Suite
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Implement unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI API response through provider_detail_service and evaluate_care_facade to API output.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.title: Render Provider Quality Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.description: Update frontend rendering logic to display provider quality snapshot fields in a structured and readable format within chat messages, ensuring compatibility with Markdown rendering and existing message components.
